title: From errors to beliefs and routes: Rethinking cortical inference
title_zh: 从误差到信念与路径：重思皮层推断
abstract: Predictive coding (PC) has long served as a unifying framework in psychology and neuroscience, linking perception and cognition to inference on sensory data. In its canonical form, PC has been closely associated with a specific cortical implementation: hierarchical exchanges between top-down predictions suppressing bottom-up prediction errors, mapped onto a stereotyped laminar microcircuit. However, recent advances in circuit-level recording and perturbation methods have cast doubt on the generality of this implementation. Across modalities, tasks, species, perceptual regimes, and their network-level implementation, empirical support for neatly segregated prediction and error units in early sensory cortex has proven limited and context dependent. Importantly, this critique does not undermine the broader idea that the brain is predictive. Instead, it motivates a shift in emphasis: predictive inference may be seen at different scales, across circuits, timescales, and behavioural states, instantiated through multiple neural mechanisms rather than a single canonical microcircuit. We review emerging evidence from visual and auditory systems, learning paradigms, and conscious versus non-conscious processing, and argue that debates about PC conflate computational, algorithmic, and implementational levels of explanation. We propose criteria for generalised frameworks that retain the inferential core of PC while specifying when, where, and how predictive influences shape perception, learning, and behaviour.
abstract_zh: 预测编码（predictive coding, PC）长期以来是心理学和神经科学中的统一框架，将知觉与认知与对感觉数据的推断联系起来。在其经典形式中，PC 常被与一种特定皮层实现紧密关联：自上而下预测抑制自下而上预测误差，并映射到刻板化的层状微回路。然而，近期在电路水平记录与扰动方法的进展对这一实现的普适性提出了质疑。跨模态、任务、物种、知觉状态及网络层级实施的证据表明，在早期感觉皮层中将预测元与误差信号元严格分离并稳定存在的支持有限且高度依赖情境。重要的是，这种批评并不动摇“大脑是预测性的”这一更广泛观点。相反，它推动了关注点转向：预测推断可在不同尺度、不同回路、不同时间尺度和不同行为状态中实现，并通过多种神经机制而非单一规范化微回路实现。本文综述了视觉和听觉系统、学习范式、以及有意识与无意识加工中的新证据，并指出关于 PC 的争论常混淆计算、算法与实现层面的解释。我们提出用于广义框架的判定标准，在保留 PC 推断核心的同时，明确何时、何地以及如何通过预测性影响塑造知觉、学习与行为。
